theme: 3 terms on collection views: the view for grids and custom layouts, the modern way to describe its layout, and the data source that animates changes from snapshots

terms.definition: A scrolling view that shows items in a grid or any custom layout, not just one column.
terms.example: The photo grid is a Collection View, the settings screen is still a table.

terms.definition: A way to build a collection layout from items, groups and sections, each sized by simple rules.
terms.example: With Compositional Layout, the carousel and the grid live on one screen.

terms.definition: A data source that takes a snapshot of your data and animates the differences for you.
terms.example: Switch to a Diffable Data Source, the insert and delete crashes go away.
terms.code:
typealias Snap =
    NSDiffableDataSourceSnapshot<Int, String>
var snap = Snap()
snap.appendSections([0])
snap.appendItems(["Tea", "Coffee"])
print(snap.itemIdentifiers)

quizzes.question: In this code, what applies `snap` to the list and animates the changes?
Which view shows items in a grid or any custom layout?
Which layout builds a screen from items, groups and sections?

video.title: Collection View, Compositional Layout & Diffable Data Source | Day 88
video.description:
Learn to explain modern collection views in UIKit: Collection View, Compositional Layout & Diffable Data Source, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Collection View - A scrolling view that shows items in a grid or any custom layout, not just one column.
Compositional Layout - A way to build a collection layout from items, groups and sections, each sized by simple rules.
Diffable Data Source - A data source that takes a snapshot of your data and animates the differences for you.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: UIKit Collection View, Compositional Layout & Diffable Data Source | Day 88
landscape.description:
Explain Collection View, Compositional Layout & Diffable Data Source in UIKit by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
컬렉션 뷰, 컴포지셔널 레이아웃, 디퍼블 데이터 소스 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Collection View - A scrolling view that shows items in a grid or any custom layout, not just one column.
한국어: 컬렉션 뷰: 한 열이 아니라 그리드나 원하는 레이아웃으로 아이템을 보여주는 스크롤 뷰

Compositional Layout - A way to build a collection layout from items, groups and sections, each sized by simple rules.
한국어: 컴포지셔널 레이아웃: 아이템, 그룹, 섹션을 간단한 크기 규칙으로 조합해 컬렉션 레이아웃을 만드는 방식

Diffable Data Source - A data source that takes a snapshot of your data and animates the differences for you.
한국어: 디퍼블 데이터 소스: 데이터의 스냅샷을 받아 바뀐 부분을 알아서 애니메이션으로 반영하는 데이터 소스

landscape.hook: Deleting one photo crashes the whole grid. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: Why did delete crash?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, deleting a photo crashes the Collection View every time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Invalid update, invalid number of items in section zero.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You call `deleteItems` before `photos` changes, so the counts don't match.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I just swap the two lines?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That works, but a Diffable Data Source avoids this whole problem.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You apply a snapshot of the data, and the Diffable Data Source works out the changes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Nice. And the grid layout, keep the flow layout?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Try Compositional Layout. Sections, groups and items, all in one Collection View.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Snapshots for the data, and Compositional Layout for the grid.
Need a grid, not a list? Use a Collection View.
